rows.jp: 結局、学校に来てもやることはない。
rows.en: In the end, there was nothing for me to do at school.

ghs.en: And in the end, I may have gone to school but there was nothing to do.

rows.jp: 帰るか。
rows.en: Maybe I should go home.

ghs.en: Should I just go home?

rows.jp: けど……こんな悠長なことでいいのかな。
rows.en: But... was it really okay to take things this easy?

ghs.en: But... I wonder if being this leisurely is right.

rows.jp: 日曜以降、世界は巻き戻される。
rows.en: After Sunday, the world would rewind.

ghs.en: Sometime from Sunday onwards, the world will be rewound.
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: 俺は何をすべきなんだろう。
rows.en: What was I supposed to do?

ghs.en: What ought I be doing?

rows.jp: 何ができるんだろう。
rows.en: What could I do?

ghs.en: What am I even capable of doing?

rows.jp: 最初に知った時、曜子ちゃんはどう思ったのかな。
rows.en: What had Youko thought when she first found out?

ghs.en: What did Youko-chan think the first time she learned of that, I wonder.

rows.jp: どんな気持ちで、あのメモを残したのか。
rows.en: What had she felt as she left that note?

ghs.en: With what feelings did she leave that memo behind?

rows.jp: 気が抜ける。
rows.en: It took the wind out of me.

ghs.en: I feel spent.

rows.jp: この人のいない、ガランとした世界でどんなに生きても。
rows.en: No matter how long I lived in this empty world, with no one else in it.

ghs.en: Whatever way I may live in this deserted world devoid of people,

rows.jp: 全部やり直し。
rows.en: Everything started over.

ghs.en: all will be redone.

rows.jp: 部活に頑張っても、食料を調達しても、逃避しても。
rows.en: Throw myself into club activities. Scrounge for food. Run away.

ghs.en: All the effort made in club, all the procuring of food, and all the running away.

rows.jp: 一週間。
rows.en: One week.

ghs.en: One week,

rows.jp: それでご破算。
rows.en: Then back to zero.

ghs.en: and it's all thrown away.

rows.jp: 精一杯生きても―――
rows.en: Even if I lived with everything I had—

ghs.en: So even if I live with all my strength---

rows.jp: ……意味があるのか。
rows.en: ...did any of it mean anything?

ghs.en: ...is there even meaning to that?

rows.jp: 空虚な考え。
rows.en: A hollow thought.

ghs.en: Vacuous thought.

rows.jp: 廊下にへたり込む。
rows.en: I slumped down in the corridor.

ghs.en: I sit down hard in the corridor.
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: もしかしたら、この世界は俺の理想郷かも知れない。
rows.en: Maybe this world was my paradise.

ghs.en: As the case may be, this world could even be my Utopia, maybe.

rows.jp: 致命傷が、致命とならない世界。
rows.en: A world where even a fatal wound never proved fatal.

ghs.en: A world where a mortal wound is not fatal.

rows.jp: 一週間で元通り。
rows.en: Everything back to normal in a week.

ghs.en: All back to what it was after one week.

rows.jp: 誰を傷つけても、誰と共依存しても。
rows.en: No matter who I hurt. No matter who I became codependent with.

ghs.en: Whoever I might wound, whoever I might co-depend on.

rows.jp: リセット。
rows.en: Reset.

ghs.en: Reset.

rows.jp: 冬子と仲良くしたら次はみみ先輩と。
rows.en: Touko one week, then Mimi the next.

ghs.en: If I get on good terms with Touko, next will be with Mimi-senpai.

rows.jp: 霧と。
rows.en: Kiri.

ghs.en: And Kiri.

rows.jp: 美希と。
rows.en: Miki.

ghs.en: And Miki.

rows.jp: 気が向いたら曜子ちゃんと。
rows.en: Youko, if the mood struck me.

ghs.en: And Youko-chan, if I feel inclined to.

rows.jp: 桜庭と。
rows.en: Sakuraba.

ghs.en: And Sakuraba.

rows.jp: ……それはない。
rows.en: ...No. Not that.

ghs.en: ...that's not gonna happen.

rows.jp: 目が痺れた。
rows.en: My eyes went numb.

ghs.en: My eyes numbed.

rows.jp: 俺は目に異常を持っている。
rows.en: I had a condition affecting my eyes.

ghs.en: I have an abnormality in the eyes.

rows.jp: 日常生活に支障はないが、ときおり、世界がおかしく見える。
rows.en: It didn't interfere with daily life, but now and then the world looked wrong.

ghs.en: There's no impediment in normal life, but sometimes, I see the world oddly.

rows.jp: 「どうして……俺一人じゃないのかね」
rows.en: “Why... am I not the only one?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Why... I want to know why I'm not alone."

rows.jp: 心が疲弊して、しばらく動けなかった。
rows.en: Emotionally drained, I couldn’t move for a while.

ghs.en: My heart was exhausted and torn, that for a while I could not move.
